references.text: The instructions for making the pure lampstand (menorah) with its lamps and utensils were given here, and Exodus 39:37 describes the completion of this work.
Here is the command to use pure olive oil for the light in the tabernacle, referred to as 'oil for the lampstand' in Exodus 39:37.
Describes the actual making of the lampstand and its utensils, which were then handed over to Moses in Exodus 39:37.
Gives instructions to keep the lamps burning continuously with pure oil, relating to the lampstand and oil mentioned in Exodus 39:37.
Describes how Aaron was to light the lamps on the lampstand, which is the same menorah mentioned in Exodus 39:37.
The book of Hebrews mentions the lampstand as part of the holy place in the tabernacle, pointing back to the object described in Exodus 39:37.
John sees seven golden lampstands in his vision, symbolically connected to the golden lampstand from the tabernacle mentioned in Exodus 39:37.
The seven flaming torches before the throne represent God's Spirit and have a symbolic connection to the lampstand and its lamps in Exodus 39:37.
Fulfillment of the regulation: 2 Chronicles confirms that Solomon followed exactly the same specification for the lampstand as was given and carried out in Exodus.
Command and fulfillment: The verse shows the specific list of items first commanded (35:14) and then delivered completed (39:37).
Narrative context: Chapter 37 describes in detail how the lampstand was made, while chapter 39 confirms that all its accessories were finished and delivered.
Material confirmation: 37:24 specifies the amount of gold (one talent) used for what is described in 39:37 as 'all its utensils'.
Production versus delivery: 37:17 describes how the lampstand was shaped, while 39:37 confirms that this specific item was ready for use.
Thematic parallel: 1 Kings shows how the principle of the wilderness lampstand was expanded and carried forward in Solomon's temple.
Command and completion: 25:31 gives the divine instruction, while 39:37 confirms that the work was done exactly according to this specification.
Construction details versus the whole: 37:22 explains how the parts were united in the work, which is confirmed in 39:37 as a finished unit.
